checks: Personnel creates a real employee without a user or credentials; default screen lists staff and opens creation only through Nuevo empleado
Usuarios has a separate list/new/edit flow; new access requires an existing own-store employee and duplicate/foreign links are rejected atomically
Linked user edits preserve the employee and really change quick login/password; posting credentials to Personnel cannot change access fields
Attendance/seller roster comes from active business users, is own-store isolated and exposes no password hashes or obsolete offline passwords
Installed online login replaces obsolete cache with current business directory; proof is nonce/session/device bound and cannot become a cash grant
Browser sessions are Caja0: cannot open money shifts or collect, but can open a table, send a comanda, keep the bill open and add the next product
Installed numbered register still opens/closes only the actual cashier shift, with direct close dialog and return to quick sale
Basic employee registry works without advanced Personnel; it cannot post salary changes or erase existing salary/vacation balances when edited
environment: Real HTTP/PHP/MariaDB guarded fictional fixture; production native authorization protocol simulated, no physical printer or real people
